$comment: Vetted gaming dropshipping catalog. Cost/sell figures are planning estimates researched Aug 2026, not live supplier quotes — verify before pricing. Consumed by the storefront page.

products.name: Monitor Bias Lighting LED Strip
products.pitch: Kills eye strain and makes any desk look like a setup video.
products.why: Most demoable product in the category — a dark-room before/after sells it in five seconds.

products.name: XL RGB Deskmat, 31.5" x 11.8", Edge-Lit
products.pitch: The foundation of every setup. Nothing else on the desk looks right without it.
products.why: Highest attach rate on the list — bundles with literally every other SKU.

products.name: Dual Controller Charging Dock
products.ipNote: Describe fitment generically ('compatible with'). No console logos on product, images, or ads.
products.pitch: Never sit down to a dead controller again.
products.why: Solves a specific recurring annoyance — the easiest kind of product to write copy for.

products.name: RGB Headset Stand with USB Hub
products.pitch: Clears the desk and adds two ports where you actually need them.
products.why: Desk-aesthetic buyer. Natural third item in a lighting + deskmat bundle.

products.name: PBT Dye-Sub Keycap Set
products.ipNote: Original or generic designs only — no franchise characters or logos on the caps.
products.pitch: Change the whole feel of your board in ten minutes.
products.why: Repeat-purchase category. Keycap buyers come back for a fourth set.

products.name: Thumbstick Grip & Precision Aim Ring Kit
products.pitch: Better grip, tighter aim, costs less than a game.
products.why: Too cheap to ad-fund standalone. Excellent as a checkout bump — near-pure margin.

products.name: Cable Management Kit
products.pitch: Turn the spaghetti behind your desk into nothing at all.
products.why: Boring product, outstanding before/after video. Same buyer as A1 and A2.

products.name: Phone Cooler + Mobile Trigger Combo
products.pitch: Stop thermal throttling mid-match, and actually aim with two fingers.
products.why: Mobile gaming is the largest audience by headcount and the cheapest to reach on paid social.

products.name: PTFE Mouse Skates Upgrade Kit
products.pitch: Glide like your mouse costs twice what it did.
products.why: Order-bump only, but carrying it signals to enthusiasts that you know the category.

products.name: Asymmetric Monitor Light Bar
products.pitch: Lights your desk, not your screen. No glare, no eye strain.
products.why: The premium version of A1 — same creative angle, meaningfully higher AOV.

products.name: 65% Hot-Swap Gasket-Mount Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
products.pitch: Thocky, wireless, and you can swap the switches without a soldering iron.
products.why: The category's hero product. Typing-sound ASMR is a proven creative format, and hot-swap cuts returns while making A5 a natural upsell.

products.name: Sub-60g Lightweight Wireless Gaming Mouse
products.pitch: Under 60 grams, flagship-class sensor, no cable drag.
products.why: Spec-shoppers buy on the sensor name — get the exact part number from the supplier in writing.

products.name: 2.4GHz Wireless Gaming Headset
products.pitch: Low-latency dongle, all-day comfort, mic your team can actually hear.
products.why: Strong seller but the highest return rate in Tier B — mic quality and comfort. Sample before listing.
products.riskNote: Highest return rate in tier. Verify mic quality on a sample.

products.name: Monitor Riser with USB Hub & Drawer
products.pitch: Raises your monitor to eye level and hides everything underneath it.
products.why: Bulky but light — check dimensional weight before you price it.

products.name: Streaming Starter Kit — USB Mic, Boom Arm, Shock Mount
products.pitch: Everything you need to sound like a streamer, in one box.
products.why: Bundle-native. Sell the outcome, never the component list.

products.name: Programmable Macro Pad with LCD Keys
products.pitch: One key per scene, per sound, per shortcut.
products.why: Streamer/creator crossover buyer. Verify the config software is in English and doesn't get flagged by Windows Defender.
products.riskNote: Confirm configuration software quality on a sample — bad software drives reviews down hard.

products.name: Pro Controller with Rear Paddles & Hall-Effect Sticks
products.ipNote: Generic brand only. Never a console-branded clone. Hall-effect = no stick drift, which is the marketing claim.
products.pitch: Rear paddles, and sticks that will never drift.
products.why: Stick drift is a universally felt pain point — hall-effect sensors are a genuine, provable fix.

products.name: VR Comfort Kit — Head Strap w/ Battery, Face Cover, Knuckle Straps
products.ipNote: Describe by headset fitment, not brand. Check the battery watt-hour rating stays under 100Wh.
products.pitch: Double your play session and stop the front-heavy headache.
products.why: Underrated. Light, near-zero IP risk, and headset owners buy accessories at an unusually high rate.

products.name: Handheld PC Accessory Bundle — Dock, Case, Screen Protectors
products.ipNote: Compatibility phrasing only — no device brand marks on product or creative.
products.pitch: Dock it, protect it, take it anywhere.
products.why: Attach-rate play on a growing installed base — the same logic that makes B8 work.

products.name: Complete Setup Bundle — Keyboard, Mouse, Headset, Deskmat
products.pitch: The whole setup, matched, in one order.
products.why: Build this instead of chairs and desks. All-light shipping, no freight risk, and it triples AOV on inventory you already carry.

products.name: Original-Art Print-on-Demand Series (6–10 pieces)
products.pitch: Art you can't buy anywhere else.
products.why: Highest-leverage item in the whole plan — the only product a competitor can't copy by finding your supplier. Commission a freelance illustrator; you own the IP outright.

products.name: Metal / Resin Dice Sets in Display Case
products.pitch: Heavy, cold, and they sound incredible on the table.
products.why: TTRPG crossover with strong repeat purchase and zero IP exposure.

products.name: Acrylic Display Case & Figure Riser Shelf
products.pitch: Show the collection off properly, dust-free.
products.why: Sells to collectors without selling them a licensed figure — captures the audience with none of the IP risk.

products.name: Non-Licensed Mecha Model Kit
products.ipNote: Original mecha designs only. Anything resembling a licensed franchise kit is a bootleg.
products.pitch: Build it yourself, then display it.
products.why: Satisfies the figure impulse through an original-design product you can advertise freely.

excluded.item: Retro handhelds preloaded with ROMs (R36S, SF3500, '20,000 games')
excluded.reason: Copyright infringement — sell blank-storage units or licensed retro hardware instead

excluded.item: Unlicensed anime/game figures from AliExpress, CJ, Temu
excluded.reason: Bootlegs — payment processor freeze and store termination risk

excluded.item: Any product carrying console or franchise trademarks
excluded.reason: Trademark takedown and ad account ban

excluded.item: Gaming chairs and desks as a launch product
excluded.reason: Freight cost, damage-in-transit, and return economics
Trade dress claims and customs seizure

excluded.item: Power banks and battery gear over 100Wh
excluded.reason: Air-freight restrictions and UN38.3 documentation burden
